item.title: Gust of wind blows baby in stroller into Lake Michigan; man helps save child
item.description: A man who jumped in to help shares his story after a gust of wind blew a baby girl in a stroller into Lake Michigan.

item.title: Hallmark Channel favorite Kristoffer Polaha stars in, directs new movie, 'Mimics'
item.description: Hallmark Channel superstar Kristoffer Polaha is starring in the big screen movie, "Mimics," which also marks his feature film directorial debut.

item.title: Chinatown welcomes Lunar New Year with a bang at Golden Dragon Parade
item.description: Chinatown celebrated Lunar New Year on Saturday at the 127th Golden Dragon Parade, hosted by the Chinese Chamber of Commerce of Los Angeles.

item.title: Temps begin to warm, making for lovely SoCal weekend after series of storms
item.description: Southern California will see a mild and sunny weekend as temperatures slowly begin to climb. By the end of next week, many areas will see summer-like temperatures.

item.title: Fresh snow and sunshine draw big crowds, heavy traffic to Wrightwood slopes
item.description: It was an ideal ski day Saturday in the local mountains, drawing heavy traffic and long lines as thousands headed to Wrightwood.

item.title: 4 people killed in fiery single-vehicle crash in Long Beach, authorities say
item.description: Four people were killed in a fiery crash early Saturday in Long Beach. A sedan crashed into a median in a tunnel, and all four passengers in the car were killed, authorities said.

item.title: Heavy rain washes out multiple sections of Angeles Crest Highway in Angeles National Forest
item.description: With the recent heavy rain leading to landslides and slope erosion, multiple sections of Angeles Crest Highway have been damaged and washed out.

item.title: Bodies of all 9 missing skiers in deadly California avalanche have been recovered, authorities say
item.description: Crews recovered the bodies of nine backcountry skiers who were killed in a California avalanche, authorities said Saturday.

item.title: Homeland Security suspends TSA PreCheck and Global Entry airport security programs
item.description: The Department of Homeland Security is suspending the TSA PreCheck and Global Entry as a partial government shutdown continues.

item.title: Man rescued from LA River after SUV crashes, overturns in Valley Village, firefighters say
item.description: A 35-year-old man was rescued from the L.A. River after firefighters said an SUV crashed and overturned in the water.
